sourceTemplate.scope: Authored decks and selectors only reused; no old rendered/PPTX geometry or qualification reused

cli.fontRoute: Maintained CLI office/visual/script-auto route for both PNG and PPTX; native host font presence remains separate

pptxFindings.message: The PPTX names Roboto, which is not on every Windows and macOS machine or not measured exactly by OPF. A viewer without it substitutes another font, and lines can break differently from the preview.
pptxFindings.help: Export with --typefaces safe (typefaces: "safe") to write Office-safe families and lay the text out with them, or install the fonts on the machines that open the file.
